fact.en: Confusing the Pallava temple styles: Mahendra style (rock-cut) vs. Mamalla style (monolithic rathas) vs. Rajasimha style (structural).
fact.hi: Confusing the Pallava temple styles: Mahendra style (rock-cut) vs. Mamalla style (monolithic rathas) vs. Rajasimha style (structural).

fact.en: Assuming the Chalukyas were only patrons of Shaivism; they were remarkably secular and patronized Jaina basadis alongside Hindu temples.
fact.hi: Assuming the Chalukyas were only patrons of Shaivism; they were remarkably secular and patronized Jaina basadis alongside Hindu temples.

fact.en: Believing society was static; 7th-century South saw a massive shift from Vedic rituals to Bhakti-based Puranic traditions.
fact.hi: Believing society was static; 7th-century South saw a massive shift from Vedic rituals to Bhakti-based Puranic traditions.
